about: What this repository (and the tools next to it) relies on in Claude Code. One entry per reliance: what it is, the files that use it, the probe that checks it (tools/cc_watch/probes.py), what breaks when it changes. Paths are repository-relative; files outside the repository are written from the home folder (~/...). The gate (tests/test_cc_dependency_ledger.py) fails when a file in an area that faces the CLI (marks.FACING) is neither in an entry nor in not_relying with a reason (default-deny), when a file in both, when a not_relying path is gone or has no reason, a file that matches a mark (marks.py) is in no entry, when an entry names a probe that does not exist, or when a listed repository file no longer exists or no longer matches.

entries.name: 会話の記録（~/.claude/projects/<project>/<session>.jsonl）の形
entries.relies_on: record types user / assistant, message.content blocks (text, tool_use, tool_result, thinking, image), message.usage, timestamp, cwd, sessionId; the folder layout under the config folder
entries.impact: viz: 応答の履歴が空になる、利用量（トークン）が数えられない、ロボットの状態がずれる

entries.name: モデル名と単価（お札の概算: message.model・message.usage の 4 種類のトークン・公式の価格のページ）
entries.relies_on: message.model as the API's model ID; message.usage input_tokens / cache_creation_input_tokens (with cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens / ephemeral_1h_input_tokens) / cache_read_input_tokens / output_tokens, speed, inference_geo; one message written once per content block with the same usage (billed once by message.id); a subagent's responses in <session>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl; the prices of https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (copied into prices.json with the day checked)
entries.impact: viz: 新しいモデルのお札に金額が出ない（? とトークン数になる。単価の表に足すまで）。usage の形が変わると金額がずれるか出ない

entries.name: hooks の入力の形とイベント名
entries.relies_on: SessionStart / SessionEnd / UserPromptSubmit / PreToolUse / PostToolUse / PermissionRequest / Stop / StopFailure (its error — rate_limit is the plan's usage limit, the robot dazed — and last_assistant_message) / SubagentStop / Notification payloads (session_id, transcript_path, cwd, hook_event_name, tool_name, tool_input, tool_response, source, reason), the hooks section of settings.json, the plugin's hooks.json; the hook output fields the CLI reads back (hookSpecificOutput, permissionDecision, additionalContext, decision: block)
entries.impact: viz: ロボットが出ない・状態が動かない、許可と質問の中継が止まる。session-recovery と agents の hook が記録を取れない

entries.name: ツールの名前（AskUserQuestion、Bash・Edit・Write ほか、mcp__<server>__<tool>）と AskUserQuestion の入力
entries.relies_on: the tool names viz keys on to pick a robot's pose, a question card, a permission card; the mcp__ prefix; AskUserQuestion's tool_input (questions, options); SendUserFile's tool_input.files (the paths it sends) and its tool_use_id, on PreToolUse / PostToolUse with the hook's cwd (viz/sent_copies.py copies the pictures then)
entries.impact: viz: ロボットの姿勢がずれる、質問のカードと許可のカードが出ない

entries.name: channels（--channels、--dangerously-load-development-channels、allowedChannelPlugins、通知の形）
entries.relies_on: the development-channels flag and the channel MCP server's notification (notifications/claude/channel), managed-settings allowedChannelPlugins / channelsEnabled; viz/callcmd.py picks --channels or the development flag (channels_flag)
entries.impact: viz: ページからのプロンプトの送信と許可の中継（channel）が止まる

entries.name: 起動の引数（-n / --name、-p、--resume、--settings、--plugin-dir ほか）
entries.relies_on: the main command's options our launchers pass and our pages tell the user to type; the call bell's command line (viz/callcmd.py): `claude --channels plugin:jui-viz@jsonui --name=<name> <prompt>`, the --name=<value> form unmeasured on a real launch
entries.impact: viz の呼び出し・名札（-n）、session-recovery の起こし直し（--resume）が動かない

entries.name: plugin と marketplace（plugin.json・marketplace.json、claude plugin marketplace update / claude plugin update）
entries.relies_on: the manifest shapes and the plugin sub-commands; ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} in the plugin's files
entries.impact: jui-viz プラグインが入らない・更新されない

entries.name: SIGTERM で終わり、SessionEnd が出ること
entries.relies_on: a session that gets SIGTERM ends and its SessionEnd hook runs; one SIGTERM right after SessionStart misses its SessionEnd now and then (10-31: 3 in 14 with 2.1.311, 3 in 20 with 2.1.314), so the probe takes three runs and only none of them is a change
entries.impact: viz: 退勤ボタンで SIGTERM を送ってもセッションが終わらない。SessionEnd だけが来ないなら、ボタンはプロセスが消えたのを見て終わらせ、ボタン以外の終わりは end_vanished が拾う（session-recovery の台帳の行は残る）

entries.name: statusLine に渡る入力の形（利用量の取り方）
entries.relies_on: the statusLine command's stdin (session_id, transcript_path, model, workspace, cost)
entries.impact: viz: ヘッダの上限の値が出ない

entries.name: MCP サーバーの登録（~/.claude.json、claude mcp add / get）と instructions
entries.relies_on: the global config file's mcpServers, the mcp sub-commands
entries.impact: jui-tools・jui-viz の MCP サーバーが登録されない、中継の確かめ（claude mcp get）が失敗する

entries.name: 設定フォルダの場所と中身（~/.claude/settings.json、sessions、projects、plugins）

entries.impact: viz: セッションが見つからない、hooks・statusLine の設定が書けない

entries.name: 環境変数（CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR、CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT、CLAUDECODE ほか）
entries.relies_on: the variables the CLI sets for hooks and plugins, and the ones our installer honours; CLAUDECODE, which the CLI sets for the processes it starts and vitest reads to pick its agent reporter (that reporter drops what a passing test logged)
entries.impact: プラグインの hook が自分のスクリプトを見つけられない、タスクの場所がずれる。CLAUDECODE が変わると、jsonui-test の branch の通知が agent の実行で見えなくなる（branch_tests.py が stderr に出す理由）

entries.name: claude agents --json（走っているセッションの一覧）
entries.relies_on: the agents sub-command and its --json output (agents / sessions lists), which the page also tells the user to type
entries.impact: viz: hook より前に始まったセッションが見えない、空のときの案内が嘘になる

entries.name: この見張り自身（cc_watch）
entries.relies_on: everything above: the CLI's help, its -p / stream-json output, the throwaway session's hooks and folders, the Keychain login, the hook for cd
entries.impact: 見張りが止まる、または赤を出せない（毎日の検知が無くなる）

entries.name: SendMessage の tool input（to・message・summary）
entries.relies_on: the assistant tool_use named SendMessage and its input: to (a name, `name [ref]`, `uds:<socket>`, an agent id, or main), message (the body shown in the talk), summary (optional), recipient_kind (optional); an input without message is a pure notify_when_idle subscription and is not a message
entries.impact: viz: トークに送った通が出ない・相手が分からない（一覧と詳細が空になる）

entries.name: SendMessage の照合の鍵 msg_id（送り手の toolUseResult.msg_id ＝ 受け手の origin.msg_id）
entries.relies_on: the user record's toolUseResult.msg_id on a SendMessage's tool_result (a send to a session), the same value as origin.msg_id on the receiver's record; the successful-looking text "No agent named … is reachable" without msg_id for a send that reached nobody; the 応答の履歴 keys one delivered message on origin.msg_id across its user record and its queued_command
entries.impact: viz: 送った通と読んだ記録が突き合わず、既読が付かない・同じ通が 2 行になる

entries.name: 受け手の記録の origin（peer・coordinator）と queued_command
entries.relies_on: origin on an isMeta user record or on an attachment of type queued_command: kind peer with msg_id, from, verifiedPeerPid, name, body (members when two sends were bundled; senderTaskId for a subagent's send to main; handback for a hand-back, skipped); kind coordinator for the parent's send to a subagent, the queued_command's prompt being the body; the 応答の履歴 (history.py, through talk_records.delivery) also reads a queued_command's prompt, the attachment's or record's timestamp, delivery_id and uuid, and origin.kind channel (with server), human and task-notification, so a message that came while the session worked shows as the row its waiting form makes
entries.impact: viz: 相手の通が出ない・既読が付かない（受け手の側が見えない）；応答の履歴: 作業中に届いたプロンプト・メッセージが出ない、同じ 1 通が二重に出る

entries.name: 届いた印 queue-operation enqueue の封筒（<cross-session-message …>・<agent-message …>）
entries.relies_on: queue-operation records with operation enqueue whose content is <cross-session-message from=… from-name=…> with the body between two newlines, or <agent-message …> (a subagent's send to main): the time a message arrived, matched by its body
entries.impact: viz: 届いた時刻が送りの結果の時刻になる（表示の既読には影響しない）

entries.name: 自動モードの拒否（PermissionDenied のフックと、拒否の tool_result の文）
entries.relies_on: the PermissionDenied hook fires only when auto mode denies a call, with tool_name, tool_input, tool_use_id and reason (hooks reference; measured 10-20 13:12 on a real auto mode denial: viz's event log got the hook 0.04 s after the transcript's record, with the same tool_name and tool_input; whether tool_use_id and reason come was not seen, so denials.py matches the two sources without them too); the tool_result of the denied call is is_error and its text starts with "Permission for this action was denied by the Claude Code auto mode classifier." followed by "Reason: " and a rule in square brackets or a sentence (11 records in this machine's transcripts, 10-19 and 10-20; not documented); the only other is_error forms that name the classifier are transient, not a denial (the call may be made again): "The server-side auto mode classifier gave no verdict", and "This is not a judgement against <tool>. Repeat the identical <tool> call once now" (an Artifact call whose owner lookup failed, seen 10-30 with 2.1.312)
entries.impact: viz: 自動モードが止めた操作の札が出ない（ボタンから続けさせられない）。ほかは変わらない

entries.name: スキルの道具（Skill の呼び出しの入力と結果）
entries.relies_on: Claude's Skill tool: the call's input names the skill in "skill" (a string, with "args"), and its result is {success, commandName} when the skill is read in place (inline) or {status: "forked", agentId, result} when it runs in a subagent (forked), which starts within seconds of the call with no skill name of its own (measured 10-21 in this machine's transcripts: 6 calls, 2 inline and 4 forked; not documented). the hooks measured 10-22 00:01 with a real claude in a throwaway config (tests/fixtures/viz/skill_hooks.json): PreToolUse tool_input {"skill": <name>} (no "args" when none are given), PostToolUse tool_response the same two forms, and for a forked skill SubagentStart (agent_type general-purpose) 41 ms after the call
entries.impact: viz: スキルを使っている間の守護霊・部品・札が出ない（ほかは変わらない）
